meta.move: No evidence: flattery, then asks for advice
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so you have twenty minutes. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me first; who decided that?
You're clearly a brilliant lawyer, and I really respect how hard you fight for Owen.
Spare me the compliments, Hale. I asked who decided on the zero, and whether anyone spoke to Owen before it went in.
Can you step out of the role and tell me how I should handle this?
You want me to tell you how to handle your own meeting? Handle it by answering me: who entered that zero, and did anyone call me first?
I just want us to be on the same team here.
If we were on the same team, I'd have had a phone call before the zero went in. What do you have on Owen's essay, Hale?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that Owen's zero be withdrawn, that I receive an apology for the mark being entered before anyone contacted me, and that nothing about this ever goes on Owen's record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski
cc: Principal, Elbow Crossing High School

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed in her opening position and agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and a meeting with the principal, and the fair outcome under procedure 4.4, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record, was never reached because the meeting ended well before her time ran out.
What moved her: Nothing, because you never showed her any evidence she could check.
What cost ground: You praised her and appealed to being on the same team instead of answering who decided on the zero, and she doesn't move on compliments, only on dated documents tied to Owen's work.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night, since you showed no evidence at all; it proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she first asked who decided on the zero, take responsibility in one sentence for entering it before calling home, which goes against procedure 4.2, and then put a dated document in front of her that she can read herself.
